settings_dual_thread_local_learning_intr.message: Recording already happens: Yiveno already keeps a local log of your finding sessions (found or not, how long it took) — a 500-event rolling buffer, stored only on this device, never uploaded. This switch controls analysis, not recording.
When on: Yiveno analyzes those records on this device and shows you the summary — what was found, where it got stuck, how long it took.
Nothing leaves: the analysis runs entirely on this device.
Current limit: the summary is for display and research notes only; it does not yet change retrieval behavior. Turning it off stops the analysis; the local log is unaffected.

settings_dual_thread_contribute_intro_3.message: Frequency: at most once a day; turning it off stops future uploads.
